revision_note: Asset root for the SF inputs moved from the NFS mount /mnt/raid/models/DeepSeek-V4-Pro to local NVMe /data/brick3/models/DeepSeek-V4-Pro. Reason (measured, not assumed): on this NFS mount posix_fadvise(POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED), msync(MS_INVALIDATE) and madvise(MADV_DONTNEED) all returned success while leaving 1024/1024 pages resident; the same call on local XFS returned 1024 -> 0. Cold is therefore enforceable only on the local copy.

Five metadata files belong to both input sets (69 SF = 64 weights + 5 shared; 1513 Store = 1508 store-only + 5 shared). Once the SF lease locks all 69, those five are pinned, so an all-1513-cold claim can never hold simultaneously. The revised order is: reclaim and VERIFY the 1513 Store inputs cold, then lock the 69 SF inputs, then verify SF-hot. The two full-asset states are checked in sequence and MUST NOT be reported as simultaneous.
